title: Define engineering rigor profiles R1-R5 and wire them into the skills
description: User request: five rigor levels (Minimal, Lightweight, Standard default, Strict, High-Assurance) users can select with the skills. Define them as a lore Spec grounded in standards, map each to concrete testing obligations in test-policy.toml, and make the gate and skills honor them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lore Spec defines R1-R5 with intended use, testing obligations, evidence, review/independence, and gate behavior per level
test-policy.toml carries a rigor profile (project default plus per-tier/per-path overrides) and tmx gate enforces the level-specific obligations
R5 gate blocks without a recorded human approval; an agent cannot self-waive R5 obligations
Each skill documents how the selected rigor changes its behavior

finalSummary: docs/specs/engineering-rigor-profiles.md defines R1-R5 (use, obligations, standards alignment verified by the standards research). tmx/rigor.py + gate: effective level = max(default, touched tiers incl. source covered by changed tests, Rigor: trailer); explicit policy only tightens. Evidence: test_rigor_levels (R1 advisory; R3 blocks; R5 blocks with no approval and with a non-listed approver, passes with a listed one), test_tier_rules_by_rigor, test_a_zero_mock_limit_is_enforced_not_ignored, test_a_trailer_raises_rigor_but_cannot_lower_it. Approvals only via TMX_PR_APPROVERS from the review record. Every SKILL.md documents its rigor behaviour.
